headline: Committee backs bill adding housing land at Maui tech park

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: Committee backs bill adding housing land at Maui tech park.
meeting.recap: One testifier asked the committee to wait until after the election to act on the item.[[0:16:03]] The main item was Bill 141 (2026), which would change county code for the Maui Research and Technology Park.[[0:18:53]] The top reason given for the bill was to switch part of the park's commercial land to residential land.[[0:24:36]] The representative said Maui has a critical need for housing, while demand for commercial space is low.[[0:24:44]] The cap on homes in the district stays at 1,250 units.[[0:26:21]] The bill would also allow minor medical centers in the park's civic district.[[0:27:22]] The planning director said the county plans a study to find a location for a South Maui transit hub.[[0:36:03]] The committee chair said residential land in the park would grow from 102.3 acres to 158 acres.[[0:43:45]]
meeting.next: After the recess, the committee planned to move on to its next agenda item.

moments.q: "There is a critical need for housing across Maui while the demand for commercial is low."
Planning director on a South Maui transit hub study
